catalogue: ESA Hipparcos (1997), CDS I/239, via NASA HEASARC
query: SELECT TOP 3000 hip_number,ra,dec,vmag,parallax,bv_color,parallax_error FROM hipparcos WHERE vmag < 7 AND parallax > 0 AND parallax_error < 0.5 * parallax ORDER BY vmag,hip_number
distance: 1000 / parallax_mas in parsecs; approximate inverse-parallax distances, relative parallax error below 50%
colour: B-V colour; missing colours use neutral 0.65
